criterionAmendments.original: Attempt exhaustion (deterministic) -> both reviewers tombstoned -> degraded round -> flow reaches terminal-success; degraded marker asserted on metrics render + /api/state + dashboard headline + AC1/AC2 report surfaces
criterionAmendments.replacement: Attempt exhaustion (deterministic) -> both reviewers tombstoned -> degraded round -> flow reaches terminal-success; degraded marker asserted on metrics render + /api/state + dashboard headline + AC1/AC2 report surfaces — EXCEPT a no-usage exhaustion (hard outage, ZERO measurable provider usage: nothing to anchor), which RETHROWS as a provenance failure per the plan's never-zero rule instead of tombstoning; completion-certainty (tombstone semantics) covers the degenerate / usage-bearing outage class
